regions.today: Much of today will be dry across Leinster with bright or sunny spells this morning and cloud increasing this afternoon. Persistent rain will spread northeastwards through the late afternoon and evening, turning heavy at times. the east and north of the region will stay dry until after dark. Highest temperatures of 13 to 15 degrees with moderate southeasterly winds.
regions.tonight: Tonight, rain will extend to all areas and will continue overnight. It will be heavy at times. Light to moderate east to southeast winds will veer fresh to strong northwesterly and gusty overnight. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 9 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday will start off wet in many areas. Rain will gradually clear northeastwards through the morning. Bright or sunny spells and scattered showers will follow through the afternoon and evening, some heavy. Highest temperatures of 10 or 11 degrees with moderate westerly winds.
